# Scraper de Glassdoor.com

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/glassdoor-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/glassdoor-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de vagas de emprego do Glassdoor.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Glassdoor (2025 update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-glassdoor)
- **Código:** [`glassdoor.py`](glassdoor.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Job pages](results/jobs.json) · [Review pages](results/reviews.json) · [Salary pages](results/salaries.json) · [Companies](results/companies.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Dados de salários de empresas do Glassdoor
- Dados de avaliações de empresas do Glassdoor
- Dados de vagas de empresas do Glassdoor

## Funções

- `scrape_jobs(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Glassdoor job listing page for job listings (with pagination)
- `scrape_reviews(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Glassdoor reviews listings from reviews page (with pagination)
- `scrape_salaries(url, max_pages=None)` → `Dict`: Scrape Glassdoor Salary page for salary listing data (with pagination)

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import glassdoor


async def main():
    jobs = await glassdoor.scrape_jobs(
        "https://www.glassdoor.com/Jobs/eBay-Jobs-E7853.htm?filter.countryId=1",
        max_pages=3,
    )
    salaries = await glassdoor.scrape_salaries(
        "https://www.glassdoor.com/Salary/eBay-Salaries-E7853.htm",
        max_pages=3,
    )
    reviews = await glassdoor.scrape_reviews(
        "https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/eBay-Reviews-E7853.htm",
        max_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos:

- **`FoundCompany`**: `name`, `id`, `shortName`, `logoURL?`, `websiteURL?`

Um campo marcado com `?` pode ser `null`.

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`glassdoor.py`](glassdoor.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: pool de proxies (datacenter ou residencial)
- `render_js` = `True`: renderiza a página em um navegador real

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/glassdoor-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_glassdoor_url`, `test_salary_range_parsing`, `test_find_companies`, `test_job_scraping`, `test_salary_scraping`, `test_review_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
